about: Follow-up design round for the 17 controls the first hand-back did not cover (DESIGN_FOLLOWUP_BRIEF.md). Same format as ui-redesign-map.json: each entry is the updated inventory record with `redesign` filled. Sizes, regions and order are measured from the rendered frames.
status_note: redesign.status is the first word of meta.status_values, as in the first map. `moved` here means the region changed against the inventory's `today`.

elements.name: Delete rig button (repeats)
elements.function: Asks whether to delete this saved Rig from the Garage; does not start a check.
elements.visible_when: signed in (Rigs can be deleted); one per saved rig

today.style: M3 IconButton, Delete icon, content description 'Delete <nickname>'

redesign.notes: Answer to question 1. A 48 x 48 dp icon button at the right end of every Rig card: a 24 dp trash icon in ink-muted, after a 1 dp vertical divider (40 dp tall) and with a 4 dp right margin. The divider splits the card in two: the left part (avatar, text, chevron) is the only part that starts a check, the right part is the bin and nothing else. Their ripples and hit areas never overlap, so a tap on the bin cannot start a check. Content description "Delete <nickname>". Shown only when signed in. One per card; the frame tags the first card, the others repeat. Pressed: ripple confined to the bin, icon turns danger-text. Drawn in rig_picker__in.png.

elements.name: Send feedback link
elements.function: Opens a new email to the beta feedback address (#182).

redesign.notes: Ghost button (teal-deep text, 48 dp high) centred at the end of the scrolling body, below the new-rig panel. It was orange text in the footer; orange text fails contrast on white, and the screen has no pinned footer, so it moved into the body. Opens the email app. Drawn in rig_picker__in.png.

elements.name: No email app line
elements.function: Tells a phone with no email app where to write instead.
elements.text: This phone has no email app. Write to <feedback address> instead.
elements.visible_when: after Send feedback is tapped on a phone with no email app

redesign.notes: Caption (13/18, ink-muted, centred) directly under the link. The address in the frame, WTIAppDev@gmail.com, is the beta address from docs/BETA_PLAN.md; the app fills in its own constant. Drawn in rig_picker__feedback_no_mail.png.

elements.name: Send feedback link
elements.function: Opens a new email to the beta feedback address, for trouble signing in (#182).

redesign.notes: Ghost button, 48 dp, centred below "Continue with Google" (and "Continue with Apple" when enabled), above the pinned "Not now". Same component as picker.feedback_link. Not hidden while an account request is busy, so a user stuck on sign-in can still write. Drawn in account__sign_in.png.

elements.name: No email app line
elements.function: Tells a phone with no email app where to write instead.
elements.text: This phone has no email app. Write to <feedback address> instead.
elements.visible_when: after Send feedback is tapped on a phone with no email app

redesign.notes: Caption under the link, same style as picker.feedback_no_mail. Drawn in account__feedback_no_mail.png.

elements.name: Beta label
elements.function: Says the offers are bought with test cards (beta build only, #182).
elements.text: Beta: test payments. Every purchase uses a test card; no real money moves.

redesign.notes: Notice card, tone "scan" (tint-orange fill, orange-deep info icon), bold body-sm text, full width at the very top of the body, above the "Buying for" line. BETA BUILD ONLY: every Paywall frame in this round is drawn as a beta build shows it. A production build leaves the notice out and everything below moves up by 80 dp. Drawn in paywall__free_pro_offer.png.

elements.name: Delete-rig dialog
elements.function: The dialog around the delete question (#169).
elements.visible_when: after the delete control of a saved Rig

redesign.notes: Answer: keeps the Material 3 AlertDialog shape, restyled like the Scan failed dialog (24 dp radius, 24 dp padding, 364 dp wide, shadow md, scrim at 55%). Opens over the Rig picker. Dismiss by scrim tap or Back is the same as Cancel, and is ignored while the delete runs. Drawn in delete_rig_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: Dialog title
elements.function: Names the Rig that would be deleted.

redesign.notes: Title style title-lg (Outfit 700 22/28). The nickname is quoted. Drawn in delete_rig_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: Dialog body
elements.text: This frees its spot in your Garage and can't be undone.

elements.name: Delete error
elements.function: Says the delete failed and the Rig is still in the Garage.
elements.text: We couldn't delete "<nickname>". It's still in your Garage; please try again.

redesign.notes: Only after a failed delete (frame delete_rig_dialog__delete_failed). body-sm 500 in danger-text, under the body text, above the buttons. The dialog stays open so the user can try again. Drawn in delete_rig_dialog__delete_failed.png.

elements.name: Yes, delete
elements.function: Deletes the Rig; the dialog stays open with the error if that fails.

redesign.notes: Destructive button, 52 dp, full width, first of the stacked buttons. While the delete runs it reads "Deleting…" and is drawn disabled (frame delete_rig_dialog__deleting). Drawn in delete_rig_dialog__question.png.
Ghost button, 52 dp, below the confirm button. Disabled while the delete runs. Drawn in delete_rig_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: Question
elements.function: Asks whether to send details of last time's crash (#184).
elements.text: RigCheck closed unexpectedly last time. Send details?
elements.visible_when: at launch, while a saved crash report is waiting (until answered)

redesign.notes: Drawn as the dialog heading (title-lg) because there is no separate title; today it is the AlertDialog body. Opens over whatever screen the app starts on (the frame uses the Rig picker). Replaced by crash_prompt.no_mail_app when Send finds no mail app. Drawn in crash_report_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: What the report holds
elements.function: Says what is in the report and that nothing is sent unless Send is tapped.
elements.text: It holds the error, the app version, your Android version and phone model. Nothing about your account or your rigs. Nothing is sent unless you tap Send.

redesign.notes: body-sm in ink-muted under the question. Hidden together with the question after "no email app". Drawn in crash_report_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: No email app line
elements.function: Replaces the question when Send finds no email app.
elements.text: This phone has no email app. Write to <feedback address> instead.
elements.visible_when: after Send is tapped on a phone with no email app

redesign.notes: Replaces the question and details (frame crash_report_dialog__no_email_app). Body 16/24 in ink. The address in the frame is the beta address; the app fills in its own constant. Drawn in crash_report_dialog__no_email_app.png.

elements.name: Send
elements.function: Opens an email to the feedback address with the report as its body and deletes the report.
elements.visible_when: while the question is shown (not after 'no email app')

redesign.notes: Primary button, 52 dp, full width, first of the stacked buttons. Hidden once the no-mail line replaces the question. Drawn in crash_report_dialog__question.png.

elements.name: Not now / OK
elements.function: Throws the report away and closes the dialog.

redesign.notes: Ghost button, 52 dp. Reads "Not now" with the question and "OK" after the no-mail line. It is the only button after the no-mail line. Drawn in crash_report_dialog__question.png.

Answer to question 2: replace the system Toast with a Material 3 Snackbar (same id, so no new id is needed). The frames already drew it: ink fill, white body-md text, 14 dp radius, 16 dp side margins, shadow md, sitting 148 dp above the bottom edge (above the pinned Restore button). Shown 4 s, then it fades. No action button. Needs a test tag: the updated inventory has none for paywall.toast (a system Toast cannot be tagged), so use "paywall_toast". Messages are unchanged ("Purchase complete!", "Pro unlocked!", "Purchases restored.", the store error). Code change: SnackbarHost in the Paywall re-skin ticket. Drawn in paywall__pro_packs.png.

answers.bin_on_rig_card: A 48 dp trash icon button at the right end of the card, behind a 1 dp vertical divider. The card body to the left of the divider is the only part that starts a check; the bin has its own hit area and ripple. See picker.rig_delete_button.
answers.paywall_toast: Replace the system Toast with a Snackbar; keep the id paywall.toast and give it the test tag paywall_toast. See revised_elements.

drift_notes: paywall.back: the updated inventory (after #186) says it is an M3 TextButton with a 24 dp ArrowBack icon and the label "Back", not "missing". The first round drew an icon-only 48 dp back button for it (content description "Back"). If tests find it by the visible word "Back", the re-skin must keep that text or move those tests to the tag paywall_back. Nothing in the frames changes.
Every other first-round element: only tests_referencing changed in the updated inventory (the counts moved from text lookups to tag lookups).
needs_new_function: None. Everything drawn already exists in the app (#169, #172, #184).
